title: Milne's rationality conjecture
summary: We prove Milne's rationality conjecture for reductions of Hodge classes on abelian varieties: The cohomological realizations of such classes pair rationally with Lefschetz classes (that is, classes in the algebra generated by divisor classes) in complementary codimension. The proof proceeds by establishing a dichotomy for reductions of Weil classes (an expected consequence of the rationality conjecture): Either they are orthogonal to all Lefschetz classes or are themselves Lefschetz classes.
